name: ENVE 3121
title: Fluid Mechanics Laboratory
description: Experimental and computational work in fluid mechanics topics, such as measurement of viscosity and flow rate, impact of water jets on surfaces, water distribution network analysis with Hardy-Cross method, hydraulic jump, open channel flow. Written laboratory reports.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required. CE 2110; MATH 2110Q; 2410Q and a lecture course in fluid mechanics; open only to students in the College of Engineering. Recommended preparation: CE 2120. This course and ENVE 3120 may not both be taken for credit.
